root.name: ランドスター・システム

relations.text: 物流事業の資産をほぼすべて買収
relations.text_en: Bought substantially all of its logistics business assets

source.label: Landstar System 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: ("Landstar Metro"), which acquired substantially all of the assets of the asset-light transportation logistics business of Fletes Avella, S.A. de C.V.

source.label: Landstar System 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: (16) Impairment of Equity Investment In 2022, the Company acquired a minority equity investment in Cavnue, LLC ("Cavnue"), a privately held start-up company focused on combining technology and road infrastructure to unlock the full potential of connected and autonomous vehicles.

companies.name: デュオス・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: データセンターの輸送をLandstarに委託
relations.text_en: Used Landstar to ship an edge data center

source.label: Duos Technologies Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Most recently, Landstar was the designated vendor involved in shipping an Edge Data Center to an Amtrak site in Secaucus, New Jersey.

relations.text: 国内輸送の運送会社として正式契約
relations.text_en: Has a formal shipping agreement with Landstar

source.label: AVITA Medical 10-Q(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Formal agreement with the following shipping carriers for domestic shipments: • Air Shipments: UPS and FedEx, Landstar • Ground Shipments: UPS, FedEx, LTL Select, Uber Freight, Landstar D.3.3.2.

relations.text_en: Administrative agent on its credit agreement

source.label: Landstar System 8-K(2026年7月)
source.quote: ("LSHI"), entered into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement among the Company, LSHI, certain subsidiaries of LSHI as subsidiary guarantors, the lenders named therein and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent (the "Restated Credit Agreement").
